web.orders: orderFiler stream on its own API Connect socket (nuvama_order_adapter.py)

notes: Nuvama streams five levels on its depth stream (quote2); a Depth subscribe is acknowledged with depth 5, and outside Depth mode the web names no depth (null), as the desktop does (feed::dialect, DepthAck::FallbackElseNull).

The desktop reaches Nuvama's plain-TCP socket through a loopback line relay (brokers/nuvama/tcp_relay.rs); the corpus plays the relay's side, so the relay's batching of whole-set requests (0.5 s quiet, 2 s at most, 0.5 s apart) is covered by the broker's own tests, not here.
No live capture of Nuvama's stream exists for the desktop: every line is built from the field names the web adapter reads.
